creed.jaymoskingdoms.crown.about: the king's word is law, and every realm should kneel to one
creed.jaymoskingdoms.chivalry.about: honour, oaths and mercy; it never takes land, and keeps long truces
creed.jaymoskingdoms.conquest.about: the sword makes the realm; it takes twice the land
creed.jaymoskingdoms.faith.about: one true faith; the realms it beats take it up
creed.jaymoskingdoms.coin.about: trade above all; it fights rich rivals for markets and takes heavy tribute
creed.jaymoskingdoms.blood.about: the old blood and its lands; it reclaims land and clashes with every other blood
